description: This PHP class 'EmailQueueService' manages email queuing, sending, and status updates within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the database via DAO, handles email composition and sending through an EmailService, and manages transaction and locking for concurrency control.

classes.name: EmailQueueService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing email queue operations such as adding emails to the queue, sending individual or all pending emails, and updating email statuses within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the EmailQueueDao instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns the EmailService instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Creates a new Mail object with specified parameters and saves it to the email queue via DAO.

methods.name: sendSingleMail
methods.description: Processes and sends a single email identified by mailId, with locking and status management.

methods.name: resetEmailService
methods.description: Resets the message fields of the EmailService instance to blank or empty.

methods.name: changeMailStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Mail object and sets the sent timestamp if applicable, then saves the change.

methods.name: sendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Fetches IDs of all pending emails and dispatches them sequentially.
